Real SEC filings (newest plain 10-K at fetch time) saved by scripts/fetch_fixtures.py.
Each folder: FilingSummary.xml plus the chosen income statement (IS.htm), balance sheet (BS.htm)
and cash flow (CF.htm) R-pages.

KNTK  - the "$ in Thousands" filer (also "shares in Thousands"); all others are "$ in Millions".
ORCL  - the non-December fiscal year end (May 31, 2026).
JPM   - the bank (bank layout: Consolidated Statements of Income).
OKE   - standard December FYE; Income Statement R3, Balance Sheet R7, Cash Flow R9.
EPD   - Balance Sheet (R3) is listed before the Income Statement (R5); CF R7.
ET    - standard December FYE; IS R4, BS R2, CF R7.
